return float(\"nan\")\n    t = str(s).strip()\n    if t == \"\":\n        return float(\"nan\")\n\n    negative = (\n        \"CR\" in t\n        or (t.startswith(\"(\") and t.endswith(\")\"))\n        or \"-\" in t\n    )\n\n    t = t.replace(\"C1\", \"\").replace(\"C2\", \"\")\n    t = re.sub(r\"[^0-9.,]\", \"\", t)\n    if t == \"\":\n        return float(\"nan\")\n\n    has_comma = \",\" in t\n       sep = \",\" if has_comma else \".\"\n        i = t.rfind(sep)\n        after = t[i + 1:]\n        if len(after) == 2:\n            t = t[:i].replace(sep, \"\") + \".\" + after\n        else:\n            t = t.replace(sep, \"\")\n\n    try:\n        value = float(t)\n    except ValueError:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return -value if negative else value\n\n\ndef parse_notes(notes):\n    notes = \"\" if notes is None or (isinstance(notes, float) and math.isnan(notes)) else str(notes)\n\n    m = re.search(r\"\\bitems=(\\d+)\", notes)\n    items = int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n\n kind=\"mergesort\",\n    ).drop_duplicates(\"record_id\", keep=\"first\")\n\n    start = pd.Timestamp(\"2025-10-01 00:00:00\", tz=\"UTC\")\n    end = pd.Timestamp(\"2025-12-31 23:59:59\",
